learn.pageTitle: Mangan and Above: Dealer Tsumo Scores
learn.pageDescription: Learn the riichi mahjong scores for a dealer tsumo of mangan or more, where every non-dealer pays the same amount ("all").
learn.bodyTitle: On a dealer tsumo, everyone pays the same ("all")
learn.body1:
When the dealer wins by [[tsumo|tsumo]], the three non-dealers each pay the same amount. This is called "all".
With no uneven split, it is easier to remember than a non-dealer tsumo.
learn.body2:
The total received is the same as a dealer [[ron|ron]].
Let us look at the dealer winning a [[mangan|mangan]] or more by tsumo.
learn.body3: As the table shows, the total matches the dealer ron score and is simply split evenly among the three non-dealers.
learn.divisionBody:
You do not need to memorize the "all" numbers separately either.
For a non-dealer tsumo you halved twice; here a single division by 3 does it. All three non-dealers pay the same amount, so there is only one kind of share.
